subject: [PATCH v6 17/19] selftests/mm: race the collapse of windows with holes

2026-09-19.patch_summary: This patch adds a test to the selftests/mm suite to race the collapse of windows with holes in memory. The test harness pins max_ptes_none to 0, causing khugepaged to only collapse a window once every PTE is present. A window with holes takes a different route and never gets raced. The test runs both ends of the occupancy scale for every driver mode, one after the other, and checks for corruption. The patch also adds code to handle the case where slots count as holes under racing MADV_DONTNEED conditions.
